project_title: Gestão Financeira Familiar - Painel do Casal
theme: Light & Dark Toggle Support (Default: Dark Slate high-contrast control panel with emerald/rose accents)
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 & 4 FUSION: Swiss Financial High-Contrast with Organic Precision

green_positive.usage: Entradas, Saldo Positivo, Contas Pagas, Metas Concluídas, Saúde Financeira Positiva

red_negative.usage: Saídas, Deficit Projetado, Contas Vencidas, Alerta de Risco

yellow_warning.usage: Contas Vencendo em Breve (1-7 dias), Atenção Orçamentária, Metas Parciais

blue_info.usage: Informações Gerais, Recorrências, Lembretes, Filtro Selecionado, Acompanhamento

sidebar.style: Dark solid navy (#0F172A) in both modes or #0D131F in dark mode for maximum contrast and clear app boundaries

topbar.style: Glassmorphism header border-b border-border backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 z-40 sticky top-0
elements: Filtro de Mês/Ano (Ex: 'Março / 2026' com acionador de seletor rápido)
Filtro de Responsável do Casal: 'Todos / Ambos', 'Eu (Marido)', 'Cônjuge (Esposa)' com badges visuais
Indicador de Saúde Financeira Geral (Pill Badge Verde/Amarelo/Vermelho)
Avatar do Usuário / Menu de Perfil / Alternador Light-Dark

layout_architecture.grid_strategy: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid. Mobile-first grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6. Card containers require internal padding p-5 or p-6.

key_dashboard_cards.title: Saldo Projetado no Fim do Mês

visual_enhancers.card_styles: border border-border/70 rounded-xl bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:border-border transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Inner light glow for critical alert cards using shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill style rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 fit-content
visual_enhancers.tables: Clean, dense finance tables with hover rows, zebra striping option, exact alignment (text left for description, badge center, currency right with font-mono).

chart_types: BarChart: Comparativo Entradas x Saídas por Mês
AreaChart: Evolução do Saldo do Casal em tempo real com gradiente sutil
PieChart / DonutChart: Distribuicão de Gastos por Categoria (Moradia, Alimentação, Lazer, Saúde, Educação, Transporte, Investimentos)
Horizontal BarChart: Divisão de Gastos por Pessoa (Eu vs Cônjuge vs Casal)

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use target transition classes: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out or transition-transform duration-200
motion_and_interactions.rule: NEVER use transition: all or universal transform transitions.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons, nav tabs, table rows must have explicit background and text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-muted/80 hover:text-foreground
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-in using framer-motion or subtle tailwind-animate keyframes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all UI strings in Portuguese (BR) and all monetary values in BRL format (ex: R$ 1.250,50).

2. Ensure the app works as an interactive Control Panel (Painel de Controle Financeiro), NOT a plain spreadsheet. Use filters, modals, inline quick-adds, full CRUD operations, mock data seeders, and dynamic updates.
3. Implement full filter support in TOPBAR: Month/Year picker and Person Filter (Todos, Marido, Esposa) which dynamically updates all statistics, graphs, and table data across pages.
4. For Contas a Pagar, organize grouped views into tabs or sections: 'Vencem Hoje', 'Próximos 7 Dias', 'Próximos 15 Dias', 'Próximos 30 Dias' and 'Atrasadas'.
5. For 'Gerar Renda Extra', build interactive goals with progress bars (e.g. 'Venda de desapegos', 'Projeto Freelancer', 'Consultoria') with remaining balance calculators.
6. Include mock state initialization with sensible financial default records for a realistic couple so the system looks full and operational immediately upon opening.
7. Implement responsive drawer/sheet or collapsible sidebar for mobile screens so the layout remains clean on smart phones.
8. Use Lucide icons consistently across the entire dashboard and sidebar.
9. Build all UI files using .js / .jsx React components consistent with the project setup.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='add-transaction-button', data-testid='current-balance-card', data-testid='person-filter-select').
Do not center-align main app container text-align globally.
Do not use transparent background in header, overlays, dropdown menus or modals.
Hover states must explicitly set hover:text-* and hover:bg-* colors.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) around cards and sections to avoid cramped design slop.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 for UI icons; rely strictly on Lucide React icons.
